scope: Static reverse engineering and mock COM trace only; no payload execution or C2 communication.

samples.identity: Obfuscated WSF downloader with AES/XOR PowerShell and managed process-transplant loader
evidence: Decoded lower-first Base64/RC4 string table and both layers of decoder aliases. Constant comparisons select the real methods amid copied dead branches.

Isolated QuickJS run exposed only mocked COM objects: synchronous MSXML2.XMLHTTP GET, creates C:\Temp, writes responseText to a randomized .ps1, then WScript.Shell.Run invokes powershell.exe -nop -ep bypass -file with window style 0 and wait=true. Modern strict-this error occurs after the launch in the mock; Windows JScript does not implement ECMAScript strict mode.

Fetched script SHA-256 aba911d9838ad6424ecad818874b2bc54636669f3964312293490c190e197f10 matches the scan. Offline AES-256-CBC/PKCS7 decryption yields a 1126248-byte script, followed by repeating-key XOR/Base64 reconstruction of a CLR assembly and a 284672-byte native PE decimal array.

Five-second watchdog checks aspnet_compiler process absence, loads the reconstructed assembly from bytes, resolves FILE.WHORE.LAUNCHER and passes the legitimate Framework executable path plus PE bytes.

CIL LAUNCHER (RVA 0x207c) retries its pipeline up to five times. Static constructor RVA 0x27a0 builds twelve ordered delegates: suspended/hidden CreateProcess-style call flags 0x08000004; parse PE headers; obtain x86/WOW64 context; read/unmap image; remote allocation 0x3000/0x40; copy headers and sections; rewrite PEB image base; set CONTEXT[44]/Eax to mapped base plus entry RVA; set context and resume.
The final native PE is importless with a single high-entropy section and a virtualized dispatcher; no final family, theft target or endpoint is established.
samples.judgment_basis: The procurement-lure carrier secretly stages encrypted executable code and replaces a legitimate process image. This is concrete covert execution, not merely use of cryptography or a malware collection label.
samples.missing_context: No host timeline, successful live injection, final payload family or observed exfiltration is established.

evidence: 32-bit MFC PE with unnamed RWX code, additional .PEC and duplicate resource sections, mismatched checksum, and low-entropy appended bytes.

Function 0x4063c0 opens HKLM Software\Classes\exefile\shell\open\command (0x406465), constructs a handler path, searches for a dot and NUL-terminates it (0x4064f7-0x406517), then calls registry-write helper 0x404610 at 0x40655c. It similarly interposes on txtfile launches.

Dispatch function 0x406a30 branches on installed wrapper names, replaces TIMPlatform.exe with the TIMP1atform.exe lookalike and runs it, and calls association installer 0x4063c0 from the installation branch at 0x406cd8.

Function 0x407210 parses embedded control records, writes files (0x4079ea), handles Run/RunServices values, modifies timestamps/attributes and launches a selected executable through ShellExecuteA at 0x407d48. Socket wrappers at 0x401900/0x401930 implement send/recv and the binary includes POP3 retrieval command paths.
The existing mailbox-specific nine-byte X-tag signature is absent in these modified bytes; no rule was widened to manufacture that extra conviction.
samples.judgment_basis: Global executable launch interception, concealed handler extension, a product-name lookalike and a control-record execution dispatcher establish a backdoor wrapper rather than ordinary association registration.
samples.missing_context: Exact deployment, a successful mailbox session and account theft are not established. Modified code/sections limit claims about complete operability.

samples.identity: Modified StormAttack/Shtormec resource DLL injector and persistence loader
evidence: Entry CRT calls 0x401cb0; configuration at 0x404120 equals 3. The selected branch calls Active Setup installer 0x401900 then diverts through .htext at 0x40f000, which calls cleanup 0x401390 and executes long canceling INC/DEC, self-move and self-exchange runs before returning.

0x401900 creates a GUID Active Setup Installed Components key and writes StubPath at 0x401a4b; reads its own image, patches configuration to mode 4, writes a self-copy at 0x401b26 and starts it with CreateProcessA at 0x401b7e.

Mode 4 uses 0x401b90 to extract resource type DLL, id 101 through 0x402460 and write it through 0x4023c0, then passes the DLL to the remote injection path. That path creates a suspended target, uses VirtualAllocEx/WriteProcessMemory, resolves LoadLibraryA and hands off through CreateRemoteThread.

Other retained modes query and replace LanmanServer Parameters\ServiceDLL with a system-directory StormServer.dll path and install a service. These are code capabilities, not the initial selected mode.
Cleanup 0x401390 obtains its own module/short path, reads COMSPEC, builds /c del <self> > nul and creates/resumes a shell process.

Resource DLL/101 is 39936 bytes with a PE header but no imports, exports or executable code section recovered. Its DLL/entry metadata is damaged. No successful DLL load, active DDoS tasking, Remcos or WannaCry behavior is asserted.
samples.judgment_basis: The selected Active Setup self-copy path, injection implementation and shell self-delete code establish malicious loader behavior despite damaged payload metadata.
samples.missing_context: Successful execution and an operational attacker endpoint are unverified. Private IP strings in the resource are not proof of network activity.

rule_changes: Relocated XOR/assembly/reflection co-occurrence from execution/payload/module-load to neutral CLR execution capabilities, preserving conditions, scope, exclusions and suspicious severity; the old matcher does not bind decoded bytes to activation.

Retired unsigned-dotnet-opaque-resource-decode-resolver-profile: unsigned status, resource entropy and decoder/delegate APIs do not establish an encrypted resource-to-payload data flow. Accurate resource, decode, interop and transplant atoms remain.

Moved signed PE unclaimed-byte size profiles to binary/layout/overlay, updated all exact YAML consumers, and required positive certificate-directory and parsed-subject evidence. Missing certificate metrics no longer make an unsigned PE appear signed. Names/descriptions now claim signer records, not verified trust or after-signing chronology.
German locale matcher now requires a language/locale assignment instead of matching a .de URL suffix.
Retired three unused quoted-key guard atoms and their OR composite: quoted prototype/constructor/__proto__ strings in an obfuscator table do not establish prototype-pollution protection.

Added a neutral literal-string if-comparison observation and a suspicious RC4/mangled-decoder/constant-branch composite, describing the missed constant-branch padding without hardcoded specimen strings.
directory_review: Destinations are existing leaves. CLR positive consumers of ancestor directories remain neutral runtime profiles. Overlay ancestor consumers already admit unclaimed-byte/overlay facts; new signed subsets add no unsigned context.
